subject.title: fix(exec-approval): distinguish non-persistable command from ask=always policy in approval prompt

question: Should maintainers continue repairing this focused PR as the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97069, or promote a broader sibling PR instead?
rationale: Multiple open candidate PRs target the same approval wording bug, and this branch still has concrete code blockers plus a contributor proof gap.

options.title: Repair this PR before merge
options.body: Keep this PR open, fix the embedded parser and native Telegram prompt coverage, and require real prompt proof before treating it as canonical.

options.title: Promote a sibling canonical fix
options.body: If a sibling PR has broader coverage and proof, preserve this PR's useful context there and close this branch after the canonical fix merges or is selected.

recommendation.title: Repair this PR before merge
recommendation.body: Keep this PR open, fix the embedded parser and native Telegram prompt coverage, and require real prompt proof before treating it as canonical.
